name: GP-33 MOD "Quite Useful" Grenade Launcher
description: The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact. One of the many items Wikelo has acquired in his travels, the 'Quite Useful' edition is a must have for any serious collector.
